title: wolfSSL PEM conversion heap-buffer-overflow candidate
bug_class: PEM / DER / Base64 decoding memory safety candidate
notes: Candidate selected for diversity batch v2. Source: GitHub issue #8353, reported heap-buffer-overflow in example/pem/pem.c involving wc_PemToDer. Must verify whether crash is inside wolfSSL library code or caused by harness logic. Minimal wc_PemToDer(CERT_TYPE) probe on commit 4bdccac58440cc589807d21d36af2331f3b8817b returned 0 and did not trigger ASan. Next step is to inspect/reproduce the issue-provided example/pem/pem.c harness. Candidate rejected after negative minimal API probe and issue discussion review. The reported crash is a harness-side NULL-termination / strlen bug, not a wolfSSL library bug.
rejection_reason: Minimal wc_PemToDer(CERT_TYPE) harness returned 0 with no ASan crash. Issue discussion indicates the reported heap-buffer-overflow was caused by the issue-provided harness calling strlen on a non-NUL-terminated file buffer, before wolfSSL was called.
